method: every row is KiCad's own `ZONE_FILLER` re-run on a SCRATCH copy of the authority followed by `routing_ledger.py --board`, which is the same connectivity the promotion gate counts.  The authority is never written.
question: D-659 priced the board's #1 fabrication blocker -- the BQ25185's own SYS OUTPUT `U11.1` reaching the TPS63020's SYS INPUT `U12.1` -- at THREE OBJECTS, and left one question open: WHERE DOES `U11.10`'s `USB_VBUS_CHG` ESCAPE GO once that copper is removed.  This answers it, and finds a SECOND three-object cut whose corridor does not collide with the escape it displaces.

rebuildable.but: the rebuild RETAKES the corridor: BQ25185_SYS regresses 5 -> 6 in every unguarded arm, and with the EAST arm reserved as a stated lane ISET routes 17.472 mm around it and STILL severs the junction while U11.10 returns NO_LEGAL_ESCAPE
rebuildable.question: D-659 never asked whether the two donor nets CAN be rebuilt after the cut
rebuildable.without_neck: U11.10: NO LEGAL ESCAPE at >= 0.500 mm; blocked by R36.1 (x15), U11.8 (x11), U11.9 (x11), board_edge (x8) -- `U11` is one of the ten fine-pitch courtyards the `.kicad_dru` pad-escape necking rule names, and the escape on the board today is a 0.200 mm neck

verdict: NO COPPER.  D-659's EAST cut is re-verified and shown to be TOPOLOGICALLY SELF-DEFEATING: its corridor IS `U11.10`'s only escape (12 relocated barrel sites of 12 sever it), and a placement shift of R36/C23 alone is vacuous in 13 cases of 13 because those parts bound the channel on the SOUTH while the copper being removed bounds it on the NORTH.  A SECOND three-object cut is found whose corridor runs WEST, through the 0.55 mm channel between C23.2 and R36.1, and does NOT exclude the escape.  The topology admits a 27 -> 26 solution and the one residual it creates (R36.2's GND bond) has a measured one-barrel answer -- but the escape the west cut frees is still NO_PATH at its own 0.500 mm class width, so the transaction is NAMED and NOT TAKEN.

The crossing has to go UNDER.

router_verdict_with_the_arm_reserved.verdict: THE WEST CUT IS BETTER POSED THAN THE EAST ONE AND IS STILL NOT ROUTABLE TODAY.  The east cut excluded U11.10's escape by TOPOLOGY (12 barrel sites of 12).  The west cut does not -- the escape is free to leave eastward -- but the corridor it then needs is refused by the board's own copper: NO_PATH at USB_VBUS_CHG's own 0.500 mm class width, and In2 under this pocket already carries GND, V3V3_FB and /I2C_SDA_INT.

but_real_drc_refuses_it.conclusion: THE SKETCH PROVES THE TOPOLOGY ADMITS A SOLUTION; IT IS NOT ONE
but_real_drc_refuses_it.tool: kicad-cli pcb drc --refill-zones, authority control run the same way
but_real_drc_refuses_it.why: the In2.Cu crossings both run over other nets' copper -- USB_VBUS_CHG shorts GND, V3V3_FB and /I2C_SDA_INT, ISET shorts V3V3_FB and /I2C_SDA_INT -- because In2 is NOT empty under this pocket.  A hand polyline on a raster is not a route
